# EU Funding News · Ullswater Investments

> Daily, verified news on European funding for innovators, researchers and SMEs: Horizon Europe, EIC, Digital Europe, defence, cohesion funds and Spanish R&D grants, with links to the official sources. Published by Ullswater Investments S.L. (Madrid), EU funding advisors. Every article cites and links an official source.

Key facts:
- Publisher: Ullswater Investments S.L. · https://www.ullswaterinvestments.com
- Contact: eufunding@ullswaterinvestments.com · Madrid: Calle Ramírez de Arellano, 17, 28043 Madrid, Spain · Brussels: Square de Meeûs 37, 1000 Brussels, Belgium
- Language: English. Updated on working days.

## Sections

- [Horizon Europe](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/horizon-europe/): Calls, work programmes and results under Horizon Europe, the EU research and innovation programme.
- [Digital & AI](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/digital-ai/): EU funding for artificial intelligence, data spaces, digital infrastructure and Digital Europe.
- [EIC, Defence & Equity](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/eic-defence/): European Innovation Council, STEP, European Defence Fund and EU equity instruments.
- [Research Policy](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/research-policy/): European Research Area, open science and the rules that shape EU-funded research.
- [Spain](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/spain/): Spanish R&D and innovation funding: CDTI, AEI, Red.es, ENISA and NextGenerationEU.
- [Health & Health Data](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/health/): EU4Health, Horizon Europe Health and the European Health Data Space.

## EU funding calls (updated daily)

- [All open and forthcoming EU calls](https://calls.ullswaterinvestments.com/): one page per call with deadline, budget, partners and official links, updated daily.
- [Closing soon](https://calls.ullswaterinvestments.com/closing-soon/)
- [Calls by theme](https://calls.ullswaterinvestments.com/theme/)

## Videos

- [All videos](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/videos/): official recordings of EU research, innovation and funding events.
- [European Research and Innovation Days 2026: Day 2 (Auditorium)](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/videos/ri-days-2026-day-2-auditorium/) (2026-11-11): Full stream of the second day in the Auditorium of the Commission's flagship research and innovation event, held in Brussels and online.
- [European Research and Innovation Days 2026: Day 1 (Auditorium)](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/videos/ri-days-2026-day-1-auditorium/) (2026-11-10): Full stream of the opening day in the Auditorium of the Commission's flagship research and innovation event, held in Brussels and online.
- [Horizon Europe Cluster 4 Info Day: Industry & Horizontal Topics](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/videos/horizon-europe-cluster-4-info-day-industry-horizontal/) (2026-10-19): HaDEA's info day on the industry topics of Cluster 4 (Digital, Industry and Space) in the 2026-2027 work programme, plus the application process.
- [Horizon Implementation Day: Finding opportunities and submitting a proposal](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/videos/horizon-implementation-day-finding-opportunities-submitting-proposal/) (2026-09-24): Commission session for newcomers: how Horizon Europe works, how to find calls and partners on the Funding & Tenders Portal and how to submit a proposal.
- [Avoiding the most common financial errors in Horizon Europe projects](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/videos/avoiding-common-financial-errors-horizon-europe-projects/) (2026-09-16): Commission session on preparing for an audit and avoiding the most common and most costly financial errors in Horizon Europe projects.

## Latest articles

- [EIT HEI Call 2026: up to €1.25M for university-led deep-tech consortia](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eit-hei-call-2026-universities-deep-tech/) (2026-11-09): The EIT Higher Education Initiative is funding HEI-led consortia that build deep-tech and manufacturing innovation capacity. Deadline: 13 January 2027.
- [EIB alliance channels over €10 billion into European scale-ups](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eib-tech-champions-alliance-10-billion-scale-ups/) (2026-11-09): Fifteen institutional investors and seven Member States join the EIB Group's European Tech Champions alliance, aiming to mobilise up to €80 billion.
- [EU and India conclude talks on India joining Horizon Europe](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/india-horizon-europe-association-concluded/) (2026-11-06): Association is envisaged for January 2027. Indian organisations would then be able to receive funding directly and lead Pillar II collaborative projects.
- [EIC 2027 work programme opens over €1.8 billion for deep tech](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eic-2027-work-programme-1-8-billion/) (2026-11-05): The Commission has adopted the EIC's 2027 plan: €578 million for the Accelerator, €248 million for Pathfinder and €100 million for a defence equity call.
- [EIC sets 19 November info day on its 2027 funding opportunities](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eic-2027-funding-info-day/) (2026-11-05): The online session will present Work Programme 2027 scheme by scheme, from Pathfinder to STEP Defence. Registration closes on 18 November.
- [CDTI Innovación commits €12.75 million to 19 R&D+I projects](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/cdti-council-19-projects-october/) (2026-11-04): All 19 October approvals are loans. Ten companies get CDTI funding for the first time, 15 are SMEs and 13 operations are co-financed by POPE.
- [Open Research Europe becomes fee-free in 11 countries](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/open-research-europe-fee-free-11-countries/) (2026-11-03): Researchers in 11 countries can now publish on the Commission's open-access platform without publication fees, under a collective funding model.
- [EU and Bpifrance plan €150 million guarantee for Ukraine partnerships](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/bpifrance-eu-guarantees-ukraine-dual-use-partnerships/) (2026-11-03): The arrangement under the Ukraine Investment Framework targets French–Ukrainian industrial ties in defence and dual-use technology.
- [Commission proposes €31.7 billion for Ukraine's defence industry](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/10/ukraine-support-loan-2027-defence-industry/) (2026-10-30): The proposal covers 2027 under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan. The Council still has to adopt it before disbursements start.
- [Canada joins EuroHPC as a Participating State](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/10/canada-joins-eurohpc-supercomputing-network/) (2026-10-30): Agreed at the EU–Canada Summit in Montreal, the move opens Europe's public supercomputing, AI and quantum resources to Canada.
- [Horizon Europe opens 14 'Health' topics for 2027, due 17 February](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/10/horizon-europe-health-2027-calls-open/) (2026-10-29): HaDEA has published the 2027 'Health' calls, from antivirals and antimicrobials to AI biomarkers and point-of-care diagnostics. Info day on 26 November.
- [First EIC defence equity call closes with nine applications](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/10/eic-step-scale-up-defence-call-closes/) (2026-10-29): The EIC STEP Scale Up Defence call offered direct equity of up to €30 million per company; results are expected in early 2027.
- [Guidelines on generative AI in research get their largest update](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/10/generative-ai-research-guidelines-update/) (2026-10-16): The ERA Living Guidelines for researchers, research organisations and funders were updated on the same day the first 13 EOSC nodes went live.
- [RAISE pledging initiative launched for AI in science](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/10/raise-pledging-initiative-ai-in-science/) (2026-10-15): Companies and philanthropic organisations are invited to support researchers who use AI, mainly with models, computing capacity, software, data and training.
- [Horizon Europe Cluster 4 opens its 2027 calls](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/10/cluster-4-opens-2027-calls/) (2026-10-13): Industry, two-stage and RAISE calls opened on 13 October; the digital call on federated and sustainable AI data processing opens on 17 November.
- [New €230 million Horizon Europe call on nature](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/10/horizon-europe-230-million-call-nature/) (2026-10-02): Ten topics to raise biodiversity spending across Pillar II of the 2026–2027 work programme, with most deadlines on 14 January 2027.
